$comment: Every lockfile the engine owns, checked by check-lock.mjs (DEPENDENCIES.md). toolchain: the engine's own (the others are what the scaffold seeds an app with, each a copy of its proven example's lockfile), installed with no install scripts. packages: the exact count, raised in the commit that adds one, with its reason. duplicates: the names allowed at two versions. prereleases: a name allowed at a prerelease, to the reason.
